subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three stale pin assertions are repaired and exact-head workflow validation passes, should this grouped set of privileged GitHub Action upgrades be approved for merge?
rationale: The action revisions are upstream-valid, but they execute in token, scanning, release, Docker, and agent workflows under a protected security label, so final acceptance of the grouped supply-chain surface is an owner decision.

options.title: Repair then approve
options.body: Keep the grouped bump, update every stale assertion, and approve it after clean exact-head workflow validation.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate token, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex Action upgrades into narrower review and rollback units.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Retain the current revisions if owners do not accept the combined privileged-action upgrade surface.

recommendation.title: Repair then approve
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped bump, update every stale assertion, and approve it after clean exact-head workflow validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the affected guard assertions and is the strongest individual workflow ownership signal in current history.
